content.value_statement: Claude rule files are easy to misconfigure when migrating from Cursor or writing scoped guidance. This skill gives correct paths frontmatter, glob examples, and file organization guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains the correct .claude/rules directory structure for modular rules.
Shows when to use paths frontmatter for file-scoped rules.
Contrasts Claude rule fields with Cursor fields such as globs and alwaysApply.
Provides examples for quoted glob patterns and recursive matching.
Helps organize global and path-scoped rules into subdirectories.
limitations: Does not validate rule files with an automated parser.
Does not create files unless the user asks the agent to edit them.
Focuses on Claude rules and does not document every Claude memory feature.
Relies on current Claude Code behavior, which may change over time.

use_cases.title: Set Up Project Rules
use_cases.description: Create a new .claude/rules structure with global and file-scoped guidance for a repository.

use_cases.title: Fix Broken Rule Frontmatter
use_cases.description: Replace Cursor-style globs or alwaysApply fields with Claude-compatible paths behavior.

use_cases.title: Migrate Cursor Rules
use_cases.description: Convert existing Cursor conventions into Claude rule files while preserving their intended scope.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Rule
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one file type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Claude rule for TypeScript files in this project. Use the correct .claude/rules location and paths frontmatter.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Rule Frontmatter
prompt_templates.scenario: Repair an existing rule that uses Cursor fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing rule file and convert any Cursor-style globs or alwaysApply settings to valid Claude rule behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Rules by Area
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a maintainable rules layout for a larger repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a .claude/rules structure for frontend, backend, and tests. Include global rules only where they are needed.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate a Rule Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration from Cursor to Claude Code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate this Cursor rules set to Claude Code rules. Preserve scope, remove unsupported fields, and explain each path choice.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a new TypeScript rule that applies only under the source directory.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns a rule file plan with the correct .claude/rules path, paths frontmatter, a quoted source glob, and concise TypeScript guidance.

output_examples.input: A user provides a Cursor rule that uses globs and alwaysApply.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains which fields are Cursor-only, removes unsupported settings, and describes the equivalent Claude rule behavior.

output_examples.input: A team wants separate guidance for tests, frontend files, and global conventions.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes an organized rules directory with scoped files, clear names, and guidance about when frontmatter should be omitted.

best_practices: Use paths frontmatter only when a rule should apply to specific files.
Quote glob patterns so YAML parses them consistently.
Keep each rule focused on one convention area or project concern.
anti_patterns: Using Cursor-only globs frontmatter in Claude rule files.
Adding alwaysApply to Claude rules instead of omitting paths for global rules.
Combining unrelated conventions into one large rule file.

faq.question: Does this skill create Claude rules automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. File creation depends on the agent and the user request.

faq.question: What field should Claude rules use for file patterns?
faq.answer: Claude rules use paths frontmatter for file-scoped behavior.

faq.question: How do I make a Claude rule apply globally?
faq.answer: Omit paths frontmatter so the rule applies without a file pattern.

faq.question: Can this help migrate Cursor rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights Cursor-only fields and maps the intended behavior to Claude rules.

faq.question: Does it support subdirectories under .claude/rules?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains that rule files can be organized recursively in subdirectories.

faq.question: Is this skill limited to Claude Code?
faq.answer: It targets Claude rule files, but marketplace metadata also supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code discovery.
